messages:
paul (People Ops): Quick post-All-Hands thread to capture the hybrid/hub questions we didn't fully answer live: commuter benefits for rides, desk swaps between hubs, emergency childcare coverage for offsites, and whether teams can block recurring pairing days. I'll tidy these into the FAQ after.

jess (Eng): Can people use commuter benefits card for one-off airport->hub rides or is that only for monthly passes?

anna (Head of Workplace): Commuter benefits are for regular commute (passes, transit). For one-off airport or intercity rides, use Expensify under "Travel - Ground". If you want a company card charge, book via the travel concierge.

carlos (Finance): Financial note: one-off ground transfers up to $90 one-way are reimbursable without pre-approval. Anything above $90 needs a short pre-approval and manager confirmation. Include receipt and trip purpose.

maria (Product): Desk swap q: if I need to swap my reserved desk in SF for a day in SEA hub, can I transfer my reservation to someone else?

paul (People Ops): Reservation transfers are allowed via the booking tool but you must mark the swap in the request so Facilities can track capacity. Transfers count toward the holder's reserved-day quota. Booking window is 6 days; max 3 reserved days per 14-day rolling window. Team block requests still need 7 business days notice.

jess (Eng): Recurring pairing days? Our team wants every-other-Wednesday in SF for 3 months. Is that doable?

anna (Head of Workplace): Recurring requests are allowed but limited: one recurring block per team at a time, and it must be approved by your manager. If more than one team requests the same week, Facilities will arbitrate based on project impact.

paul (People Ops): Childcare support: we're piloting two programs for the upcoming offsite  a $175 per-family childcare travel stipend (requires invoice) and an emergency on-site backup caregiver pool for day-of coverage (limited slots). Managers should approve stipend-eligible folks ahead of booking.

carlos (Finance): Stipend will be reimbursed after receipts are uploaded; code as "Offsite:Childcare". For backup caregiver pool, Facilities/Events will coordinate invoicing to avoid personal payment whenever possible.

maria (Product): Any guidance on PTO vs offsite attendance? If I'm traveling but not attending sessions, can I still expense travel?

paul (People Ops): If travel is company-approved for work (even if you miss 1 day of sessions), expenses are eligible. If you add personal days before/after, separate those nights on your expense report and mark personal. Don't mix personal charges into the company claim.

office-bot: Provisional event "Product Offsite - Tentative" added Sep 10-11 to company calendar. RSVP open.

paul (People Ops): Action items: I'll post an FAQ summary, link to the booking transfer flow, and the stipend sign-up form. DM me for urgent visa or accessibility accommodation needs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
